column1: # Settings the SmartClock images set that oncore-core, the record's provider, does not act on, each excused by the project owner (smartclock-gps's Declaration::unacted; smartclockmon docs/firmware/gps.md, "The fields").  oncore-core's test holds that each setting the images set is one it acts on (record.rs, DECLARED) or one of its rows here, and that no row is for a setting it acts on or one no image sets.

column3: an output the engine sends from the record's almanac (@@An); nothing for the module to change
the LEA-M8T applies its own ionosphere and troposphere models, and no setting turns either off (UBX-13003221 R28, CFG-NAV5, CFG-NAVX5)
the LEA-M8T measures on GPS time's second (CFG-RATE) and takes no epoch offset
the module takes no differential corrections, so has none to smooth
the board speaks the binary protocol alone, not NMEA (@@Ci)
